_comment: Fixtures for 02-pairs/escalation.py. Texts are real where they can be: pair
symptoms (P0003, P0014, P0015, P0035, P0046, P0057) and demo presets 1 and 4.
Profiles mirror the demo family in 06-demo/server.py, plus two built to

fires.name: P0015: vague heaviness in a 71-year-old diabetic fires R1 and R2
fires.text: I have felt unusually tired since yesterday and slightly short of breath walking to the gate. No real pain, just a vague heaviness. I put it down to the heat but my wife thought I should ask.

fires.name: P0035: clammy, feels wrong, calls it indigestion, fires R1 and R2
fires.text: My gran has gone very quiet and clammy this afternoon and says she just feels wrong. She keeps saying it is indigestion. She is not complaining of pain as such.

fires.name: P0046 wording: a chest that is 'not right' is vague enough for R1
fires.text: Chest has not been right today.

fires.name: preset 1: a classic crushing presentation is not mild, so R1 stays silent
fires.text:
Heavy pressure in the middle of my chest that has not let up for almost half an hour. I feel sick and I am sweating.
T+0:00 began while sitting watching television. T+0:04 spread to the jaw. T+0:11 sweating and nausea. T+0:26 unchanged after resting.

fires.name: exertional tightness in known coronary disease fires R3
fires.text: I get a tight band across my chest when I climb the stairs at work. It has been the same for about a year.

fires.name: preset 4: walking named to rule it out is not exertional
fires.text: Sharp pain in my left chest, worse when I breathe in. It eases if I sit up and lean forward. Walking around does not change it.

fires.name: P0003: pain on breathing during chemotherapy fires R4
fires.text: I am sorry to trouble you. I am halfway through chemo and about two hours ago I got a sudden pain in my chest when I breathe in, and I am more out of breath than I have been. I did not want to make a fuss but it has not gone.

fires.name: P0014, in poor spelling: pain on breathing and a fatter leg after a hip op fire R5
fires.text: been in bed 2 wks since my hip op and now got a pain in my chest wen i breath in started this morning and my right leg is fatter than the left

fires.name: the same text, surgery 20 weeks ago, is outside the 3-month window
fires.text: been in bed 2 wks since my hip op and now got a pain in my chest wen i breath in started this morning and my right leg is fatter than the left

fires.name: unexplained tiredness in a woman fires R6, flag only
fires.text: I have felt unusually tired for days, no pain anywhere.

fires.name: a denied symptom fires nothing
fires.text: I am not tired at all, it is a tight chest after a run.

fires.name: pain on breathing, denied, does not fire R4
fires.text: It does not hurt when I breathe, I just have a cough.

fires.name: no profile fact, no R1 or R2: P0015's text on a 29-year-old woman fires only R6
fires.text: I have felt unusually tired since yesterday and slightly short of breath walking to the gate. No real pain, just a vague heaviness. I put it down to the heat but my wife thought I should ask.

escalation.name: R1 raises green one level, to yellow
escalation.text: Chest has not been right today.

escalation.name: R1 raises yellow to red
escalation.text: Chest has not been right today.

escalation.name: a red stays red and R1 is reported as supporting it
escalation.text: Chest has not been right today.

escalation.name: R3 raises green to yellow
escalation.text: I get a tight band across my chest when I climb the stairs at work. It has been the same for about a year.

escalation.name: R3 is capped at yellow and does not raise a yellow
escalation.text: I get a tight band across my chest when I climb the stairs at work. It has been the same for about a year.

escalation.name: R3 under a red supports only 'at least yellow'
escalation.text: I get a tight band across my chest when I climb the stairs at work. It has been the same for about a year.

escalation.name: P0057 on Mum: R1 raises to red, R3's yellow cap does not hold it back
escalation.text: It is honestly nothing. I get a bit of tightness walking the dog up the hill, it goes when I stop. I have had it for months and I would not have mentioned it.

escalation.name: two rules firing still raise one level in total
escalation.text: I have felt unusually tired since yesterday and slightly short of breath walking to the gate. No real pain, just a vague heaviness. I put it down to the heat but my wife thought I should ask.

escalation.name: a flag never changes the verdict
escalation.text: I have felt unusually tired for days, no pain anywhere.

escalation.name: R5 raises yellow to red
escalation.text: been in bed 2 wks since my hip op and now got a pain in my chest wen i breath in started this morning and my right leg is fatter than the left
